CREATE TRIGGER tr_CustomerPOBQ
ON CustomerPOULBQ
AFTER INSERT

AS

BEGIN	

	DECLARE @systemUserName VARCHAR(50) = 'trigger'
	DECLARE @currentDate DATETIME = GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time'

	DECLARE @nullDate DATE = '01/01/1900'

	DECLARE @poStatusNew VARCHAR(20) = 'NEW'
	DECLARE @poStatusDone VARCHAR(20) = 'DONE'
	

	-- *************************
	DECLARE @companyIdSBIC INT = 6
	DECLARE @companyIdMTC INT = 12

	DECLARE @companyCodeSBIC VARCHAR(15) = 'SUNCOAST'
	DECLARE @companyCodeManila VARCHAR(15) = 'MANILA'
	DECLARE @companyCodeMTC VARCHAR(15) = 'MTC'
	-- *************************

	-- puregold
	-- *************************
	DECLARE @customerIdPuregold INT = 670
	-- *************************

	-- landmark 
	-- *************************
	DECLARE @customerIdLMTrinoma INT = 16
	DECLARE @customerIdLMAlabang INT = 540
	DECLARE @customerIdLMNuvali INT = 541
	DECLARE @customerIdLMManilaBay INT = 981

	-- landmark branch
	DECLARE @branchIdLMTrinoma INT = 547
	DECLARE @branchIdLMAlabang INT = 2449
	DECLARE @branchIdLMNuvali INT = 2450
	DECLARE @branchIdLMManilaBay INT = 3985
	-- *************************


	-- lee plaza
	-- *************************
    DECLARE @customerIdLPSuperPlaza INT = 130;
    DECLARE @customerIdLPCityCentral INT = 132
    DECLARE @customerIdLPHypermart INT = 211
	
	
	-- lee plaza branch
	DECLARE @branchIdLPSuperPlaza INT = 389
	DECLARE @branchIdLPCityCentral INT = 391
	DECLARE @branchIdLPHypermart INT = 772
	-- *************************
	   	
	
	-- alturas 
	-- *************************
	DECLARE @customerIdPlazaMarcela INT = 792;

	DECLARE @branchIdPlazaMarcela INT = 3437;
	-- *************************


	-- shoppers mart
	-- *************************
	DECLARE @customerIdShoppersMart INT = 73;

	DECLARE @branchIdShoppersMart INT = 186;
	-- *************************


	-- online 
	-- *************************
	DECLARE @customerIdLazada INT = 224;
	DECLARE @customerIdShopee INT = 841;
	DECLARE @customerIdTikTok INT = 1025;

	DECLARE @branchIdLazada INT = 1911
	DECLARE @branchIdShopee INT = 3570
	DECLARE @branchIdTikTok INT = 4129
	-- *************************


	-- *********************************************
	IF NOT OBJECT_ID ('tempdb..#tmpPO') IS NULL DROP TABLE #tmpPO

	SELECT CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(@companyCodeManila, TRIM(Header.companyName)) > 0 THEN
			@companyIdMTC
		WHEN CHARINDEX(@companyCodeMTC, TRIM(Header.companyName)) > 0 THEN
			@companyIdMTC
		WHEN CHARINDEX(@companyCodeSBIC, TRIM(Header.companyName)) > 0 THEN
			@companyIdSBIC
		ELSE
			-1
		END AS companyId,
		
		UPPER(TRIM(dbo.func_NoNextLine(Header.companyName))) AS companyName,
		CAST(-1 AS INT) AS warehouseId,

		CAST(-1 AS INT) AS customerId,
		UPPER(TRIM(dbo.func_NoNextLine(Header.customerName))) AS customerName,

		UPPER(TRIM(Header.poRefNumber)) AS poRefNumber,
		
		CASE
		WHEN ISNULL(Header.poDate, @nullDate) <> @nullDate THEN
			Header.poDate
		ELSE
			CAST(@currentDate AS DATE)
		END AS poDate,

		CASE
		WHEN ISNULL(Header.deliveryDate, @nullDate) <> @nullDate THEN
			CASE
			WHEN Header.poDate > Header.deliveryDate THEN
				Header.poDate
			ELSE
				Header.deliveryDate
			END
		ELSE
			CASE
			WHEN ISNULL(Header.poDate, @nullDate) = @nullDate THEN
				CAST(@currentDate AS DATE)
			ELSE
				Header.poDate
			END			
		END AS deliveryDate,

		CASE
		WHEN ISNULL(Header.cancellationDate, @nullDate) <> @nullDate THEN
			CASE
			WHEN Header.poDate > Header.cancellationDate THEN
				DATEADD(DAY, 1, Header.poDate)
			ELSE
				Header.cancellationDate
			END			
		ELSE
			CASE
			WHEN ISNULL(Header.poDate, @nullDate) = @nullDate THEN
				CAST(DATEADD(DAY, 1, @currentDate) AS DATE)
			ELSE
				DATEADD(DAY, 1, Header.poDate)				
			END				
		END AS cancellationDate,
			   		
		CAST(-1 AS INT) AS customerBranchId,
		UPPER(TRIM(dbo.func_NoNextLine(Header.customerBranchName))) AS customerBranchName,				
		
		UPPER(CASE 
        WHEN TRY_CAST(LEFT(Header.customerBranchName, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL THEN 
			-- numeric
			SUBSTRING(Header.customerBranchName, PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', Header.customerBranchName), PATINDEX('%[0-9][^0-9]%', Header.customerBranchName + 't') - PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', 
                    Header.customerBranchName) + 1) 
        ELSE 
			-- not numeric
			UPPER(TRIM(dbo.func_NoNextLine(Header.customerBranchName)))
		END) AS customerBranchLookUpCode,
		

		CAST(CASE 
        WHEN TRY_CAST(LEFT(Header.customerBranchName, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL THEN 
			-- numeric
			1
        ELSE 
			-- not numeric
			0
		END AS BIT) AS isNumericBranchLookUpCode,

		UPPER(TRIM(dbo.func_NoNextLine(Header.remark))) AS remark,

		CAST(-1 AS INT) AS productId,
		CAST(-1 AS INT) AS skuId,
		UPPER(TRIM(Detail.customerSKUCode)) AS customerSKUCode,
		UPPER(TRIM(Detail.customerSKUDesc)) AS customerSKUDesc,

		CASE 
		WHEN ISNULL(Detail.poQty, 0) = 0 THEN
			Detail.poQtyPcs
		ELSE
			Detail.poQty
		END AS poQty,

		CASE 
		WHEN ISNULL(Detail.unitPrice, 0) = 0 THEN
			Detail.unitPricePcs
		ELSE
			Detail.unitPrice
		END AS unitPrice,

		Detail.discountPercent,

		CASE 
		WHEN ISNULL(Detail.netPrice, 0) = 0 THEN
			Detail.unitPricePcs
		ELSE
			Detail.netPrice
		END netPrice
	INTO #tmpPO
	FROM CustomerPOULBQ Header
		INNER JOIN CustomerPOULDetailBQ Detail ON Detail.poRefNumber = Header.poRefNumber
			AND Detail.customerName = Header.customerName
	WHERE poStatus = @poStatusNew

--SELECT * FROM #tmpPO WHERE CAST(deliveryDate AS DATETIME) <> CAST(@nullDate AS DATETIME)

--SELECT @nullDate
	-- *********************************************


	-- customer
	-- *********************************************
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.customerId = Customer.customerId 
	FROM Customer 
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON REPLACE(#tmpPO.customerName, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(Customer.lookUpCode, ' ', ''), '%') 
	WHERE Customer.lookUpCode <> ''
		AND Customer.isActive = 1
	-- *********************************************

-- SELECT * FROM #tmpPO WHERE customerBranchId

	-- customer branch
	-- *********************************************
	-- numeric branch lookup code
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.customerBranchId = CustomerBranch.customerBranchId 
	FROM CustomerBranch 
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON #tmpPO.isNumericBranchLookUpCode = 1 
			AND #tmpPO.customerId = CustomerBranch.customerId 
			AND #tmpPO.customerBranchLookUpCode = CustomerBranch.lookUpCode
	WHERE CustomerBranch.lookUpCode <> ''


	-- non-numeric branch lookup code
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.customerBranchId = CustomerBranch.customerBranchId 									
	FROM CustomerBranch 
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON #tmpPO.isNumericBranchLookUpCode = 0 
			AND #tmpPO.customerId = CustomerBranch.customerId 
			AND REPLACE(#tmpPO.customerBranchLookUpCode, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(CustomerBranch.lookUpCode, ' ', ''), '%') 			
	WHERE CustomerBranch.lookUpCode <> ''	
	

	-- fixed branch Id
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.customerBranchId = CASE
									-- landmark
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLMTrinoma THEN
										@branchIdLMTrinoma
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLMAlabang THEN
										@branchIdLMAlabang
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLMNuvali THEN
										@branchIdLMNuvali
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLMManilaBay THEN
										@branchIdLMManilaBay

									-- lee plaza
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLPSuperPlaza THEN
										@branchIdLPSuperPlaza
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLPCityCentral THEN
										@branchIdLPCityCentral
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLPHypermart THEN
										@branchIdLPHypermart

									-- alturas
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdPlazaMarcela THEN
										@branchIdPlazaMarcela

									-- lazada
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdLazada THEN
										@branchIdLazada

									-- shopee
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdShopee THEN
										@branchIdShopee

									-- tiktok
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdTikTok THEN
										@branchIdTikTok	
										
									-- shoppers mart
									WHEN #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdShoppersMart THEN
										@branchIdShoppersMart	

									ELSE
										#tmpPO.customerBranchId 
									END
	-- *********************************************

	
	
	-- warehouse
	-- *********************************************
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.warehouseId = CustomerBranchWarehouse.warehouseId 
	FROM CustomerBranchWarehouse
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON #tmpPO.companyId = CustomerBranchWarehouse.companyId 
			AND #tmpPO.customerBranchId = CustomerBranchWarehouse.customerBranchId 
	WHERE CustomerBranchWarehouse.isPrimary = 1
	-- *********************************************	



	-- sku
	-- *********************************************		
	-- no puregold customer
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.skuId = CustomerSKU.skuId 
	FROM CustomerSKU
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON #tmpPO.customerId <> @customerIdPuregold
			AND #tmpPO.customerId = CustomerSKU.customerId 
			AND #tmpPO.customerSKUCode = CustomerSKU.customerSKUCode 


	-- puregold customer (chamonix)
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.skuId = CustomerSKU.skuId 
	FROM CustomerSKU
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON #tmpPO.customerId = @customerIdPuregold
			AND #tmpPO.customerId = CustomerSKU.customerId 
			AND REPLACE(RIGHT(SPACE(20) + #tmpPO.customerSKUCode, 20), ' ', '0') = REPLACE(RIGHT(SPACE(20) + CustomerSKU.customerSKUCode, 20), ' ', '0')

			-- AND #tmpPO.customerSKUCode = CustomerSKU.customerSKUCode 		
	-- *********************************************	



	-- product
	-- *********************************************	
	UPDATE #tmpPO SET
		#tmpPO.productId = SKU.productId 
	FROM SKU
		INNER JOIN #tmpPO ON #tmpPO.skuId = SKU.skuId 			
	-- *********************************************	




	-- *********************************************	
	SET XACT_ABORT ON 
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
	
	INSERT INTO CustomerPOUL(
		companyId, companyName, warehouseId, 
		customerId, customerName,
		poRefNumber, poDate, deliveryDate, cancellationDate,
		customerBranchId, customerBranchName, customerBranchLookUpCode,
		remark, createBy, updateBy)
	SELECT PO.companyId, 
		PO.companyName,
		PO.warehouseId, 
		
		PO.customerId, 
		PO.customerName, 

		PO.poRefNumber, 
		
		MAX(PO.poDate) AS poDate,
		MAX(PO.deliveryDate) AS deliveryDate, 
		MAX(PO.cancellationDate) AS cancellationDate,

		PO.customerBranchId,
		PO.customerBranchName,
		PO.customerBranchLookUpCode,

		MAX(PO.remark) AS remark,
		@systemUserName AS createBy,
		@systemUserName AS updateBy
	FROM #tmpPO PO
		LEFT JOIN CustomerPOUL Header ON Header.customerId = PO.customerId
			AND Header.poRefNumber = PO.poRefNumber
	WHERE Header.customerId IS NULL
		AND Header.poRefNumber IS NULL
	GROUP BY PO.companyId, PO.companyName, PO.warehouseId,
		PO.customerId, PO.customerName, PO.poRefNumber, 
		PO.customerBranchId, PO.customerBranchName,
		PO.customerBranchLookUpCode

	INSERT INTO CustomerPOULDetail(
		customerId, poRefNumber, productId,
		skuId, customerSKUCode, customerSKUDesc,
		poQty, unitPrice, discountPercent, netPrice)
	SELECT PO.customerId, 
		PO.poRefNumber, 
		PO.productId,
		PO.skuId, 
		PO.customerSKUCode, 
		PO.customerSKUDesc,
		PO.poQty, 
		PO.unitPrice, 
		PO.discountPercent, 
		PO.netPrice
	FROM #tmpPO PO
		LEFT JOIN CustomerPOULDetail Detail ON Detail.customerId = PO.customerId
			AND Detail.poRefNumber = PO.poRefNumber
			AND Detail.customerSKUCode = PO.customerSKUCode
	WHERE Detail.customerId IS NULL
		AND Detail.poRefNumber IS NULL
		AND Detail.customerSKUCode IS NULL


	UPDATE CustomerPOULBQ SET
		CustomerPOULBQ.poStatus = @poStatusDone,
		CustomerPOULBQ.updateBy  = @systemUserName,
		CustomerPOULBQ.updateDate = @currentDate 
	FROM #tmpPO PO
		INNER JOIN CustomerPOULBQ ON CustomerPOULBQ.poRefNumber = PO.poRefNumber
			AND CustomerPOULBQ.customerName = PO.customerName

	COMMIT TRANSACTION
	-- *********************************************

END

RETURN
